## `GET /compare`

Runs lined up by knob and stage, from run\_metrics. Aligns; does not rank.

| Parameter | In    | Type     | Required | Description                               |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `runs`    | query | `string` | Yes      | comma-separated run ids, in display order |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [ComparisonResource](/reference/api/models/#comparisonresource)   |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /experiments`

Lists experiments.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                     |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [ExperimentResource](/reference/api/models/#experimentresource) |

## `DELETE /experiments/{name}`

Delete an experiment with its runs, analyses and finished tuning sessions; only ever a user's request. delete\_scenarios also removes the saved scenarios built on its runs, which otherwise block. 409 with the blocks.

| Parameter          | In    | Type      | Required | Description       |
| ------------------ | ----- | --------- | -------- | ----------------- |
| `name`             | path  | `string`  | Yes      |                   |
| `delete_scenarios` | query | `boolean` | No       | Default: `false`. |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                                    |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [ExperimentDeleteImpactResource](/reference/api/models/#experimentdeleteimpactresource) |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror)                       |

## `GET /experiments/{name}`

Returns one experiment with its runs, comparison and latest analysis.

| Parameter | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`    | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [ExperimentDetail](/reference/api/models/#experimentdetail)       |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /experiments/{name}/analyze`

Compare the experiment's analysed runs with servtuner compare.

| Parameter | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`    | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [ExperimentAnalyze](/reference/api/models/#experimentanalyze) or `null` (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                            |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [ExperimentAnalysisResource](/reference/api/models/#experimentanalysisresource) |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror)               |
